module_summary: PTP time-distribution leaf: deserializes a serial TD stream, crosses it to the local clock, and disciplines local ToD/relative timestamp counters with a sample-clock phase detector, DDS phase loop and PI period controller.

anchors.name: ptp_td_sdi
anchors.why: Serial time-distribution input bit stream from the PTP master, fed through input pipeline

anchors.name: output_ts_rel
anchors.why: Relative timestamp output built from ts_rel_ns_reg and fractional ns

anchors.name: output_ts_tod
anchors.why: Time-of-day timestamp output built from seconds, ns and fractional ns registers

anchors.name: period_ns_reg
anchors.why: PI-controlled local clock period added each cycle to advance the timestamps

anchors.name: locked
anchors.why: Lock indication: AND of PTP, frequency and DDS sync lock flags

anchors.name: output_pps
anchors.why: Pulse-per-second output generated on ToD seconds rollover

anchors.name: output_ts_rel_step
anchors.why: Indicates relative timestamp was stepped/reloaded

anchors.name: output_ts_tod_step
anchors.why: Indicates ToD timestamp was stepped/reloaded

anchors.name: output_pps_str
anchors.why: Stretched PPS level, cleared halfway through the second

anchors.name: td_shift_reg
anchors.why: 16-bit deserializer shift register collecting serial TD bits

anchors.name: bit_cnt_reg
anchors.why: Counts 16 bits of a TD word after start bit detection

anchors.name: td_index_reg
anchors.why: Word index within TD frame, forms low nibble of word ID

anchors.name: td_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Deserialized 16-bit TD word captured from shift register

anchors.name: td_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: One-cycle valid for each deserialized TD word in ptp_clk domain

anchors.name: td_tlast_reg
anchors.why: Last word of TD frame; restarts source sync delay counter

anchors.name: td_tid_reg
anchors.why: TD word ID (message, index) selecting which shadow field is loaded

anchors.name: td_sync_reg
anchors.why: Toggle per TD word used to cross word into clk domain

anchors.name: dst_td_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Valid of TD word in local clk domain, gates shadow register updates

anchors.name: dst_td_tdata_reg
anchors.why: TD data word captured in clk domain after toggle synchronizer

anchors.name: dst_td_tid_reg
anchors.why: TD word ID in clk domain decoded to select shadow fields

anchors.name: src_ns_reg
anchors.why: Reconstructed source ns time in ptp_clk domain, compared against local time

anchors.name: src_sync_delay_reg
anchors.why: Delay countdown after frame end before loading source time shadow

anchors.name: src_load_reg
anchors.why: Loads source ns and period from shadow registers

anchors.name: src_phase_reg
anchors.why: Phase counter whose carry produces periodic source update

anchors.name: src_sync_reg
anchors.why: Toggle marking source time updates, synchronized to clk and sample_clk

anchors.name: src_marker_reg
anchors.why: Toggle on source load, resets destination load counter

anchors.name: src_period_reg
anchors.why: Source clock period used to advance src_ns_reg

anchors.name: src_ns_shadow_reg
anchors.why: Shadow of source ns assembled from TD words 6-8

anchors.name: sample_acc_reg
anchors.why: Accumulates sample-clock phase detector edge differences

anchors.name: sample_cnt_reg
anchors.why: Sample period counter dumping accumulator every 16 sample clocks

anchors.name: edge_1_reg
anchors.why: Phase/frequency detector output: destination edge leads source

anchors.name: sample_acc_sync_reg
anchors.why: Phase error sample crossed into clk domain, drives DDS loop

anchors.name: sample_acc_sync_valid_reg
anchors.why: Enables DDS loop filter update when new phase sample arrives

anchors.name: dst_phase_reg
anchors.why: DDS phase accumulator whose carry generates dst_update events

anchors.name: dst_phase_inc_reg
anchors.why: DDS phase increment from loop filter, tracks source update rate

anchors.name: dst_update_reg
anchors.why: DDS overflow pulse capturing local time and gating timestamp checks

anchors.name: dst_sync_reg
anchors.why: Destination sync toggle fed to phase detector, gates timestamp loads

anchors.name: dst_err_int_reg
anchors.why: Integral term of DDS phase loop filter

anchors.name: dst_gain_sel_reg
anchors.why: Selects high/low gain for DDS loop filter

anchors.name: dst_sync_lock_count_reg
anchors.why: Hysteresis counter for DDS sync lock detection

anchors.name: dst_sync_locked_reg
anchors.why: DDS sync lock flag feeding locked output

anchors.name: dst_load_cnt_reg
anchors.why: Counts DDS updates since source marker; zero enables timestamp load

anchors.name: ts_ns_diff_reg
anchors.why: Source minus local ns time error input to PI period controller

anchors.name: ts_ns_diff_valid_reg
anchors.why: Enables PI controller update on new time error

anchors.name: time_err_int_reg
anchors.why: Integral term of PI period controller with saturation

anchors.name: gain_sel_reg
anchors.why: Selects PI gain based on time error magnitude

anchors.name: dst_ns_capt_reg
anchors.why: Local timestamp captured at DDS update for comparison

anchors.name: src_ns_sync_reg
anchors.why: Source ns captured on synchronized source toggle

anchors.name: ts_sync_valid_reg
anchors.why: Source capture pending; with capt valid triggers comparison

anchors.name: ts_capt_valid_reg
anchors.why: Local capture pending; with sync valid triggers comparison

anchors.name: phase_err_acc_reg
anchors.why: Coarse phase detector edge accumulator

anchors.name: phase_err_out_reg
anchors.why: Coarse phase error used for frequency lock and pre-lock correction

anchors.name: phase_err_out_valid_reg
anchors.why: Enables frequency lock evaluation on new coarse phase error

anchors.name: freq_lock_count_reg
anchors.why: Hysteresis counter for frequency lock

anchors.name: freq_locked_reg
anchors.why: Frequency locked; selects fine vs coarse error and gates PTP lock

anchors.name: ptp_lock_count_reg
anchors.why: Hysteresis counter for PTP time lock

anchors.name: ptp_locked_reg
anchors.why: PTP time lock flag feeding locked output

anchors.name: ts_rel_ns_reg
anchors.why: Relative timestamp ns counter, stepped from shadow on mismatch

anchors.name: ts_tod_ns_reg
anchors.why: ToD nanoseconds counter; rollover increments seconds and fires PPS

anchors.name: ts_tod_s_reg
anchors.why: ToD seconds counter

anchors.name: ts_tod_offset_ns_reg
anchors.why: ToD ns offset from TD message added to shared ns LSBs

anchors.name: dst_rel_ns_shadow_reg
anchors.why: Shadow of master relative ns assembled from TD words

anchors.name: dst_rel_shadow_valid_reg
anchors.why: Relative shadow complete; enables relative timestamp check

anchors.name: dst_tod_s_shadow_reg
anchors.why: Shadow of master ToD seconds assembled from TD words

anchors.name: dst_tod_shadow_valid_reg
anchors.why: ToD shadow complete; enables ToD timestamp check

anchors.name: ts_rel_load_ts_reg
anchors.why: Forces relative timestamp reload after repeated mismatches

anchors.name: ts_tod_load_ts_reg
anchors.why: Forces ToD timestamp reload after repeated mismatches

anchors.name: ts_rel_mismatch_cnt_reg
anchors.why: Counts consecutive relative timestamp MSB mismatches

anchors.name: ts_tod_mismatch_cnt_reg
anchors.why: Counts consecutive ToD timestamp mismatches

groups.name: TD deserializer
groups.description: Pipelines serial TD input, detects start bits, shifts 16-bit words and tags them with IDs

groups.name: TD clock-domain crossing
groups.description: Toggle synchronizer moving TD words from ptp_clk into clk domain

groups.name: Source time reconstruction
groups.description: Rebuilds master ns time in ptp_clk from TD shadow fields and period

groups.name: Sample-clock phase detector
groups.description: Compares source and destination sync toggles on sample_clk, accumulates phase error

groups.name: DDS phase loop
groups.description: PI-filtered phase accumulator generating local update events locked to source updates

groups.name: Period PI controller and lock
groups.description: Compares source vs local time, PI-adjusts period_ns_reg, tracks frequency and PTP lock

groups.name: Timestamp counters
groups.description: Relative and ToD timestamp counters advanced by period, PPS generation

groups.name: Timestamp shadow and step check
groups.description: Holds master timestamp MSBs from TD, compares and steps local counters on mismatch
